Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1-3: 5 Cursor specialists in parallel + generic Codex + Claude generic; rounds 4+: single generic Cursor → Codex → Claude fallback.

**Round 1 results**: 2 accepted findings, 1 rejected nit. All accepted fixes applied (see Step 7 commit).

## Rejected Code Review Findings
### [Code Review] Cursor-Structure (round 1)
**Finding**: `skills/implement/SKILL.md:1490` — The `HAS_BUMP=false` warning no longer tells the operator what a custom `/bump-version` skill should implement.
**Reason not implemented**: Intentional (Change C in the issue). The inline description duplicated the bump-version SKILL.md; operators should consult that skill. Shorter warning is deliberate.
